sections.text: Precision’s SaaS Academy page says Martell started the coaching program in 2017 and that Precision acquired it in February 2026. The two primary pages therefore differ on the launch year. They agree on Martell’s founder connection, but this directory does not resolve the date discrepancy by inference. The acquisition is presented as Precision’s dated statement.

sections.title: Why the difference is visible
sections.text: Founding, program launch and later company activity can refer to different milestones, but the sources here do not explicitly reconcile their wording. A careful profile can identify the conflict and still report the association that both sources support. Researchers needing a precise incorporation or launch date should seek a record addressing that particular question.

sections.title: Separate current and historical roles
sections.text: The current personal site and the acquirer’s page describe different organizations and activities. A reader should not transfer a founder title into a claim of present control of the acquired program. This profile does not estimate transaction proceeds, ownership percentages or income. For current program delivery, consult Precision’s materials; for Martell’s present offerings, consult his own current site.
